evidence.r1: Glass only on the nav bar, the scheme toggle, the colour switch, the lens picker, Order and the lens menu; all controls.
evidence.r2: The 'Nickel' selection pill and the '45 mm' menu row are fills, not stacked glass.
evidence.r3: Five small controls (nav, scheme, colour, lens, order), each load-bearing.
evidence.r4: All the capsules and the menu share one frosted regular material in both schemes.
evidence.r5: No clear variant; the wood grain is blurred into the frost.
evidence.r6: No control is tinted, Order included, so the 'at most one' limit holds.
evidence.r7: The bars show the blurred wood through them (light and dark).
evidence.r8: Capsules, a circle and a fixed-radius menu.
evidence.r9: The 'Nickel' pill is concentric in the colour capsule; the menu's selected row sits mid-menu, with no pinched corner.
evidence.r10: All floating buttons are capsules or a circle.
evidence.r11: Two groups at the top (nav, toggle) and three at the bottom (colour, lens, order).
evidence.r12: The nav is text-only, with the icon toggle on its own glass; the bottom controls are text buttons.
evidence.r13: Material sits on each capsule, not on the labels inside.
evidence.r14: The three bottom capsules are evenly spaced and deliberately separate, one material.
evidence.r15: The brief scrolls sensor/lenses/body/price beneath the bars, but no capture shows scrolled content or an edge effect; the full page is one viewport.
evidence.r16: At rest every bar sits over the textured wood-and-camera photo.
evidence.r17: The camera sits clear of both bars; only the wood backdrop is under them.
evidence.r18: Dark labels on pink glass ~13:1 (light); white labels on brown glass ~7:1 (dark).
evidence.r19: Reduced capture: the Nickel/Graphite selection pill all but disappears (white on white), so the chosen body colour can't be read.
evidence.r20: The hero photo runs to all four window edges, with the bars floating over it.
evidence.r21: At rest the camera is placed clear of the top and bottom bars; there is no sidebar.
evidence.r22: The dark scheme dims the whole photo, not a layer under the bars; no borders or backings are added.
evidence.r23: The lens menu opens in place of the lens picker, and a pointer glow shows on the selected row in the dark menu.
evidence.r24: Labels are monochrome, and the colour swatches are grey and black.
evidence.r25: Near-black labels on pink glass over orange wood (light), white over brown (dark); none is close to the wood.
